phase: exact proposal accepted; final runtime and content gate pending
rationale: Fine settled dust is explicitly collected by a dustpan, household vacuum and ordinary microfiber wet mop in original manufacturer usage. Preserve the old earth/landscape approximation everywhere else. This is a narrow game-feedback decision, not synonym ownership or a graph relation.

sources.claim: CADE1926–1931 describes the scoop used to collect sweepings.
Manufacturer-branded dustpan-and-brush instructions explicitly collect fine dust; the implements store together.
DEX2009 and DOOM2005/2021 name the household floor-washing tool.
Original Romanian manufacturer instructions explicitly say the microfiber mop collects dust and hair from floors. This supports a dust association without asserting every mop is a dry duster.
Manufacturer names mop/bucket, water absorption, hard floors and particle collection.
DEX1998/2009 records the suction apparatus for dust and other particles/gases.
Original household vacuum description names dust collection, hard floors and carpets.

required_acceptance: Each exact Praf→target is accepted, nonwinning, hot and rank>1 with the same projected ID and normal attempt/repeat accounting.
All non-whitelisted targets retain their exact baseline Praf response, including Pământ, Mătură, Burete de vase, Găleată, Detergent, native Praf de copt and Lapte praf.
Other Pământ-cluster terms such as noroi and bolovan do not inherit this exact surface exception.
No graph node/edge/form is created; no native exact-pair cascade or broad Casa/Aspirator proxy is introduced.
No private answer IDs, descriptions, routes or hidden labels appear before exact win.
Missing neighborhood anchor in custom fixtures retains the existing fallback behavior.
extra_boundaries: All465 authored projection term records and all71 legacy native scorer mappings must remain exact.
Do not extrapolate fine household dust to every qualified powder or every cleaning implement.
Do not infer all mops are dry dusters or all household vacuums require water.
Raw factual acceptance is not portable promotion, C1-C6 approval or human playtesting.
held_targets: Burete de vase: dish-specific cue/neighborhood weakness; no casual bathroom-owner or graph repair.
